correctness.rationale: For arbitrary a,c>0 and 0<alpha<1, the exact covariance is U/(1-r^2). Applying the Gaussian zero identity and harmonicity gives the exact positive Dirichlet-energy deficit (1). The Fourier coefficient beta identity has the exact gamma-ratio form (2), verified independently at finite indices; its k^{-1-alpha} tail gives finite total energy and the exact sharp shell coefficients. Localizing the positive nonlinear denominator near the single cusp proves the subcritical and critical terms; away from the cusp the shell contribution is O(1-r). For alpha>1/2, radial and angular boundary gradients converge strongly in L^2, giving the linear coefficient. Limits and positivity were checked. The accompanying finite checker passed 40 tests but is not invoked as an infinite proof.
